subject: Renewal + reserved pool increase — throughput carveout request
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <ops@november-ai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + reserved pool increase — November AI

Hi Laura / Marissa,

We’re coming up on our renewal and want to lock in an expanded reserved pool for Q3–Q4. After the last three months of traffic growth we’re forecasting an additional 12 GPUs (NVIDIA A100 equivalent) to be reserved for our production inference cluster. Key asks from our side:

- Throughput assurance: support for a minimum sustained throughput of ~3k tokens/sec for our core chat workload (50th–90th percentile).
- Latency SLOs: p95 user-facing latency target around 800ms or better for our 2k token requests.
- Recovery carveout: because this is an architecture change (redistribution between pools) we’d like an SLA carveout for the first 30 days, with explicit uptime credits for sustained issues after that.

Can you share: pricing for the 12-GPU add-on over a 12-month term, an initial implementation timeline, and a proposed SLA amendment text we can review? I’ve attached a quick capacity_estimate.xlsx with our traffic profiles.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Lane
Head of Platform Ops | November AI
(attachment: capacity_estimate.xlsx, type: xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <ops@november-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + reserved pool increase — November AI

Sophie — thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet, that helps. High-level response:

- We can reserve an additional 12-GPU pool scoped to your account and route traffic to it within the same private tenancy.
- Proposed throughput: we can guarantee a sustained throughput floor of 3,000 tokens/sec for the pool under normal operating conditions (subject to model mix/prompt distribution).
- Latency SLO: target p95 <= 800ms for the specified payload distribution; we recommend continuing to use our prefix caching for hot prompts to hit lower medians.
- SLA carveout: we can offer a 30-day onboarding carveout during which we won’t levy penalties for migration friction, followed by an SLA with uptime credits starting on day 31.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll loop in our Legal/Contracts teammate and share a short amendment that captures term, pricing, and the carveout language for your review.
2) We’ll schedule a 60-minute ops kickoff to agree migration steps and acceptance criteria (can your infra leads do Wed/Thu next week?).

I’ve flagged this for Marissa for commercial terms and Karthik for technical acceptance criteria.

– Laura
Laura Bennett | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Sophie — pricing and term options below (high level):

Option A — 12-month term (standard): +12 GPUs reserved, $62,000/month commitment (list-equivalent $75k) with a 5% term uplift credit applied to overall usage for the first 2 billing cycles. SLA as discussed (30-day carveout).
Option B — 12-month term (prepay annual): +12 GPUs reserved, $680k prepay (5% discount vs monthly), includes an onboarding credit of $25k for migration services and 1 dedicated ops runbook session.

If you sign on Option B within 10 business days we can bump the uptime credit multiplier to 1.25x for any incurred credits in the first contract year.

I’ll prepare a short amendment draft for the SOW (pricing table + carveout) and share the DocuSign link. Karthik / Steph, please confirm the technical acceptance criteria items — p95 latency target, throughput floor, and the playbook for failover.

— Marissa

Subject: Re: Renewal + reserved pool increase — November AI

Quick technical addendum from my side:

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Provision additional 12 GPUs in a dedicated reserved pool within 7 business days of contract signature.
- Throughput floor: 3,000 tokens/sec sustained for the pool during reported traffic windows; Redwood to provide traces and token-rate dashboards for verification.
- Latency: p95 <= 800ms for requests <= 2k tokens; p50 target <= 300ms.
- Rollback plan: if regression is observed during onboarding, Redwood will execute a rollback to previous routing within 4 hours and trigger a remediation runbook.

We’ll also provide an acceptance verification checklist the day the new pool is live. Happy to review the capacity_estimate.xlsx — it looks consistent with the ask.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Lane <ops@november-ai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Ross <cto@november-ai.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + reserved pool increase — November AI

Thanks all — the technical criteria look good. Two contract asks before we proceed:

1) We need explicit wording in the SOW that defines the throughput guarantee and the measurement method (Redwood to publish 1-minute token-rate and p95 latency dashboards for the pool; November to have read access).
2) SLA carveout granularity: carveout only applies to configuration/migration issues in first 30 days; any unplanned outages beyond 15 minutes after day 31 should trigger uptime credits on a 4x multiplier for this reserved pool for the remainder of the term.

I’ve attached an internal note with suggested wording and the capacity_estimate.xlsx again. If you can include those two items in the amendment we can route to procurement immediately.

We’re inclined to take Option B (annual prepay) if the 4x multiplier is included and if we get the onboarding credit formalized.

Regards — Sophie
Sophie Lane | Head of Platform Ops, November AI
(attachment: capacity_estimate.xlsx, redwood_amendment_draft.docx)

- SLA carveout: 30-day onboarding carveout for configuration migration, then SLA with uptime credits; for this reserved pool we’ve agreed to a 4x credit multiplier for qualifying outages after day 31.
- Commercials: Option B annual prepay with $25k onboarding credit and the upgraded multiplier if signed within 10 business days.

Attached is the redwood_amendment_draft.docx and a PDF of the SOW (november_signed_SOW_v2.pdf) for your review.
